spec.description: Hybrid dashboard optimized for a 15840×2430 wall display. Layout compacted to 62 Grafana grid rows (24 columns), providing practical vertical headroom for Grafana chrome while preserving native Grafana charts and editable SQL. Business Text chrome/KPI typography was tightened to reduce clipping in the compressed layout. | Tile-layout revision: vertical KPI stacks converted to multi-column tiles and dashboard repacked to 54 grid rows (~2044px grid canvas). | 15840x2430 responsive revision: KPI labels standardized to 18px and values to 48px at wall resolution, with container-query fallbacks. KSA SVG map uses expanded safe viewBox and contained drawing area to prevent clipping. | MAP RESTORED: returned panel-28 to its known-working in-flow Dynamic Text SVG implementation, with safe viewBox padding and automatic SVG rebuild if Grafana clears it. | VIDEO WALL FIT: expanded content from 54 to 67 grid rows to remove the large bottom gap while retaining safety versus the former 76-row layout. KSA map is strictly clipped inside its panel, uses a padded viewBox, separate legend strip, shorter visible labels, and retains original data-region keys. | NATIVE MAP REVISION: panel-28 converted from Dynamic Text SVG to native Grafana Geomap with status-colored regional markers and alarm halo highlighting. | SQL migration: data_sample queries remapped to the python-GrafanaETL normalized PostgreSQL schema; UI/layout/viz configuration preserved. Metrics absent from the new schema are returned as NULL rather than sourced from the legacy table.

SELECT
  region,
  capital,
  latitude::double precision AS latitude,
  longitude::double precision AS longitude,
  status,
  alarms,
  CASE
    WHEN alarms > 20 THEN 'Critical'
    WHEN alarms > 10 THEN 'Warning'

    WHEN alarms > 10 THEN 36
    ELSE 0
